name: ClapClip AI
tagline: Local AI face swapping and media tools for Windows 10 and 11
description:
ClapClip AI is a Windows desktop application for AI-assisted photo and video work. Its face-swap workflow imports local media, lets users choose a source face and inspect a real-time preview, then renders on a compatible NVIDIA, AMD or Intel GPU. Desktop face-swap media stays on the PC rather than being uploaded to a cloud service.

The app supports photos, videos, multiple faces and batch workflows. Practical video length and render performance depend on the GPU, resolution and available storage. Other features include image and video enhancement, offline audio transcription and short-video creation. The Windows app is free to download, while face-swap exports require an in-app purchase. Linked free online tools are separate services with their own upload handling. Only edit faces with consent and use media you have rights to process.
